scope: Bounded primary-source follow-up for the observed periodic-saddle switching candidate; not an exhaustive priority search.
queries: "Some mathematical models for flagellar activation mechanisms" "chaos"

primary_sources.title: Encoding via conjugate symmetries of slow oscillations for globally coupled oscillators
primary_sources.access: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata; full text requires access and was not used.
primary_sources.relevance: Established slow switching between periodic cluster states and conjugate symmetries, including a phase-energy extension. Not the motor equations.

primary_sources.title: Spatiotemporal coding of inputs for a system of globally coupled phase oscillators
primary_sources.access: Primary author-hosted ten-page PDF; Sections I-II inspected.
primary_sources.relevance: Five phase oscillators with sinusoidal and second-harmonic coupling, a 2+1+2 cluster network, and noise/input-dependent switching. Different field and dimension.

primary_sources.authors: Peter Ashwin, Ozkan Karabacak and Thomas Nowotny
primary_sources.title: Criteria for robustness of heteroclinic cycles in neural microcircuits
primary_sources.access: Full primary publisher HTML; Section 2.3, Theorem 3, Section 3.3 and discussion inspected.
primary_sources.relevance: Conditional robustness criterion for cycles containing unstable manifolds within invariant subspaces whose destinations are sinks. Existence of connections is a hypothesis; robustness alone does not prove attraction.

conclusion: The general mechanism is established. No exact motor-network result was found in this bounded retrieved material. Exact-model priority remains unresolved, including the previously recorded unread theses. No author contact or access bypass was attempted.
